description: Diarised transcript of a session, chunked by segment offset/limit (limit default 50, max 100). Falls back to raw-text chunks of ~4000 chars each when no structured dialogue exists, with its own smaller page size (limit default 5, max 6). The response reports total_segments; page with 'offset'.

limit.description: Segments to return (default 50, max 100). The raw-text fallback uses a smaller page size - default 5, max 6 - since each item is a ~4000-char text chunk.

name: chargen_get_transcript
title: Get session transcript
